stage_1_l1_cross_l1_5.runs: L1 Haiku (done in B6.3) + L1.5 Gemini basic (B6.5a on full 151K)

auto_merge.rule: L1 Haiku MERGE >= 0.88 AND L1.5 Gemini basic MERGE >= 0.88
auto_merge.threshold_choice_rationale: user chose 0.88 vs calibration-supported 0.85 for safety margin; costs 15-20 auto-applies vs 0.85

auto_skip.rule: L1 Haiku SKIP >= 0.97 AND L1.5 Gemini basic SKIP >= 0.97
auto_skip.calibration_precision: ~99% (L1 alone 100% @0.97, L1.5 alone 96.2% @0.97; joint expected higher)
auto_skip.fn_risk: At 4-way SKIP >=0.90 saw 3.2% FN rate; tight ~0.97 threshold should cut FN significantly

stage_2_l2_cross_l2_5.runs: L2 Haiku rich + L2.5 Gemini rich on Stage 1 escalations

auto_merge.rule: L2 Haiku rich MERGE >= 0.90 AND L2.5 Gemini rich MERGE >= 0.90

auto_skip.rule: L2 Haiku rich SKIP >= 0.95 AND L2.5 Gemini rich SKIP >= 0.95

escalate_to_stage_3: L2 MERGE or SKIP below auto-thresholds

web_search.decision_rule:
Based on L3 residual count after Stage 2:
- <1,000 pairs -> use web ($15-30)
- 1,000-3,000 -> use web ($30-90)
- 3,000-10,000 -> L3 no-web bulk + web on sub-sample of disagreements
- 10,000+ -> revisit Stage 2 thresholds before running L3
web_search.calibration_evidence: Ablation was thin (4 overlap pairs, 100% agreement). Cost per pair $0.147 with web vs $0.012 no-web.

l4_opus_audit.role: cross-pair pattern check on full B6.5a output before B6.5b review
looks_for: MERGE pairs that look wrong in aggregate
PC patterns that suggest new IDENTITY_RULES subsection

pc_routing_rule.principle: Basic-prompt PC (L1, L1.5) is noise regardless of confidence (6-9% precision across all bands). Rich-prompt PC (L2, L2.5) at high confidence is more trustworthy. Cross-tier PC agreement is the strongest signal.
route_to_user_review_iff: 2+ tiers emit PARENT_CHILD at any confidence (cross-tier agreement)
L2 Haiku rich OR L2.5 Gemini rich emits PARENT_CHILD at conf >= 0.90 (rich-prompt high-conf PC)
L3 Sonnet emits PARENT_CHILD at any confidence (rigor tier always routes PC to user)
pc_routing_rule.otherwise: Treat single-tier basic-prompt PC or rich-prompt low-conf PC as noise. Follow cross-tier non-PC consensus (apply MERGE/SKIP auto-thresholds to the non-PC verdicts).
pc_routing_rule.projected_review_pile_reduction: Previous rule (any PC -> review) projected 3,000-5,000 pairs. Refined rule projects 1,500-3,000 pairs.

skip_audit.purpose: Verify 4-way SKIP FN rate at scale
skip_audit.pairs_source: random sample of auto-SKIP bucket post Stage 1
skip_audit.decision_rule: FN rate <2% -> thresholds OK. FN 2-5% -> tighten SKIP threshold. FN >5% -> re-run ladder with tighter thresholds.

b6_5_a_scope: L1.5 Gemini basic on all 151K pairs
SKIP audit spot-check (200 pairs through L2+L3)
L2 Haiku rich + L2.5 Gemini rich on Stage 1 escalations
Decide L3 web on/off based on residual count
L4 Opus inline audit across full output
Produce merge queue preview for B6.5b
b6_5_b_scope: Batch user review of 1,500-5,000 flagged pairs
Claude presents context pack + recommendation per pair
User signs off in batches by pattern (parent-child, rename, private-label, accent, importer-prefix)
Build final merge queue for B6.6 execution
notes: All thresholds committed by user 2026-04-17 based on calibration results. Symmetric thresholds per B6.3 user preference ('do it right the first time'). Cross-family agreement is the reliability anchor, not confidence magnitude. PC always escalates. L3 web defer decision preserves safety on hard cases while managing cost.
